name: How long does custom interior framing take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom interior framing take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing a single partition wall or closet typically takes 1 to 2 days, while framing a full basement remodel or room addition can take 1 to 2 weeks. The timeline depends heavily on structural engineering requirements, such as placing support beams or handling existing load-bearing walls. Site readiness also plays a major role; clearing mechanicals, ductwork, and existing plumbing must happen before or alongside framing. Because owner Abraham Becerra leads work directly on-site, framing is coordinated closely with subsequent trades like plumbing and electrical rough-ins to keep the project moving without unnecessary downtime.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small wall additions take 1 to 2 days, while complete basement layouts or additions take 1 to 2 weeks, depending on structural scope and site conditions.
